checks.rationale: The decomposition follows all in-scope action blocks: separate group-specific membrane labeling for each of the three dishes, one genuine intact-cell pooling operation, a composite scRNA-seq library-preparation interface, two distinct library/read channels and a joint interpretation result. The common labeling caption is not treated as prior pooling. The starting mRNA vignette is correctly treated as biological-target context, without inventing an RNA isolation branch. The primary paper establishes a shared preparation followed by separation of barcode-derived and endogenous cDNA products, so the multi-output composite block is justified; its effects distinguish each product origin. Separate sequencing instances preserve channel attribution and do not assert separate instrument runs. No neighboring-row workflow or unshown routine protocol is imported.
